policy.near_duplicate_banks: one entry per exact bank question; no answers merged
policy.log_only_variants: exact_bank=false variants are observed wordings, never bank aliases; stored once per cluster on its primary entry, not repeated per bank
policy.score_definition: log-only confidence: 0.75*Jaccard(content tokens) + 0.25*trigram Dice against the canonical wording; no substring boost; not a match weight
policy.wording_source: observed krillocity_prompts.jsonl wordings only; no invented aliases

limits.cap_policy: exact-bank variants and the canonical wording survive first; remaining log-only variants are trimmed by descending observed frequency then text
